observations: Q2 iron ore production was 84.3 Mt, the highest second-quarter output since 2018; sales were 79.7 Mt, up 3% y/y.
Q2 copper production was 98.4 kt, up 6% y/y and the best second-quarter output since 2017.
Q2 nickel production was 42.0 kt, up 4% y/y; Q1 copper and nickel had also grown strongly y/y.
S11D, Capanema/VGR1, Salobo, Sossego and Onca Puma/Long Harbour contributed to the operating improvement, while Oman pellet plants had a temporary suspension.
contradictions: Broad production improvement does not by itself establish margin or free-cash-flow improvement because realized commodity prices and costs are not captured in this Scout artifact.
unknowns: current quantified environmental and tailings-risk status

recommendation.reason: Fresh issuer production evidence closes Scout execution coverage; economics/risk quantification remains with Alpha and causal/externality judgment with Beta.
